result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    eight=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==8]
    other=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (0,8)]
    if not eight or not other: return g
    er0=min(r for r,c in eight); er1=max(r for r,c in eight); ec0=min(c for r,c in eight); ec1=max(c for r,c in eight)
    or0=min(r for r,c in other); or1=max(r for r,c in other); oc0=min(c for r,c in other); oc1=max(c for r,c in other)
    # move along the axis on which the objects are separated
    if oc0>ec1 or ec0>oc1:
        if oc0>ec1: d=ec1-oc0+1
        else: d=ec0-oc1-1
        dr,dc=0,d
    else:
        if or0>er1: d=er1-or0+1
        else: d=er0-or1-1
        dr,dc=d,0
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for r,c in other: out[r][c]=0
    for r,c in other: out[r+dr][c+dc]=g[r][c]
    return out"}

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    a=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(a); w=len(a[0])
    p8=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if a[r][c]==8]
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if a[r][c]!=0 and a[r][c]!=8]
    if not p8 or not p: return a
    r8=[x[0] for x in p8]; c8=[x[1] for x in p8]
    rp=[x[0] for x in p]; cp=[x[1] for x in p]
    minr,maxr=min(rp),max(rp); minc,maxc=min(cp),max(cp)
    R0,R1=min(r8),max(r8); C0,C1=min(c8),max(c8)
    dr=dc=0
    # move along the separating axis until one-cell adjacency
    if maxr < R0 and not (maxc < C0 or minc > C1): dr=R0-maxr-1
    elif minr > R1 and not (maxc < C0 or minc > C1): dr=-(minr-R1-1)
    elif maxc < C0: dc=C0-maxc-1
    elif minc > C1: dc=-(minc-C1-1)
    # clear moving pixels, then place translated
    for r,c in p: a[r][c]=0
    for r,c in p: a[r+dr][c+dc]=grid[r][c]
    return a"}
